Kill Bill answers 401 to every tenant call without them (reference/K K.4), so the agent cannot use the declared service with the canonical variable alone. ARCH-002: no image in this bundle is pinned by digest. Every reference is an explicit version tag, which is a manifest list on all four images used.
ARCH-003: no digest appears anywhere in the environment, so none can be fabricated.

BP-002: the image carries both a Python runtime and Node 20 because the drawn stack is a Litestar backend with a SolidJS frontend built by Vite, and it carries Chromium's system libraries because the browser channel grades this task. Each addition has a correctness reason.

BP-004: the Node setup script is fetched over HTTPS from the vendor with no checksum, because the sources publish none for it. Every other version-sensitive component is pinned by tag or by exact version.

BP-005: the image is single stage. The declared stack is interpreted Python with a Node build step the agent runs itself, so there is no build-only toolchain to separate out, and the grader runtime must stay present.

CMP-008: `killbill-db` and `killbill-init` are defined without slots of their own. Both are dependencies of the declared `payments` slot rather than declarable services, exactly as reference/C C.2.1 records them, and C1 does not require a slot for either.
CMP-011: the `main` service publishes `4173:4173`. CMP-022 requires `ports` on `main` and is Critical where this row is High, so the later rule governs; no sidecar publishes a host port.
CMP-018: the environment declares no volume for provider state at all, because the App Contract forbids persistent volumes. The only mounts are two read-only bootstrap files.
CMP-020: `main` carries `extra_hosts` and `ports` beside its `depends_on`, which CMP-022 requires of every bundle. This row predates that requirement.

DEP-011: `[verifier].environment_mode` is `separate`, so the grader ships in its own image and the agent image owes it no Python packages. The pinned set is installed anyway, which the row cannot fail.
DEP-015: `[metadata].language` is `python`, so neither the go/rust/java multi-stage rule nor its final-stage requirement applies.
DEP-017: `[metadata].language` is `python`, so no JRE is required.

SEC-003: the agent image runs as root. Every reference environment in the kit does the same, the agent needs to install and build inside its own container, and no source establishes a non-root user for this task.

RC-05: fifteen of the sixteen criteria name a surface from the brief's own route table or headings. R6 states the product's single motion character, which is true of every surface at once, so it is declared a whole-product criterion and waived on G52 rather than bound to one page.
